name: Golden Designs Catalonia 8-Person Near-Zero EMF FAR Infrared Sauna
description: Golden Designs Catalonia 8-Person PureTech™ Near-Zero EMF (Under 3 mg) FAR Infrared Sauna - Canadian Hemlock Step into the world of ultimate relaxation and rejuvenation with the Catalonia 8-Person Ultra-Low EMF Far Infrared Sauna. Experience the blissful embrace of gentle, healing heat as it envelops your body, melting away tension and promoting overall well-being. Crafted with care, this spacious 8-person sauna is designed to deliver the utmost comfort and therapeutic benefits. The advanced Ultra-Low EMF technology ensures that you can indulge in the warmth without any worries, providing you with a safe and soothing environment. The far-infrared heat penetrates deep into your muscles, offering a range of health benefits, from relieving stress and improving circulation to detoxifying your body. Bask in the luxurious ambiance of the Catalonia sauna and create unforgettable moments of relaxation with your loved ones. Elevate your wellness journey and embrace the power of radiant heat with this exquisite addition to your home. Features 8-person capacity Near Zero EMF - EMF Under 3 mg when sitting 2 to 3 inches from the heating panels 8 Custom-designed portable comfort benches Bluetooth and MP3 auxiliary connection Interior and Exterior LED control panel (3 sets of control panels to operate the whole sauna) Interior reading lights Galaxy Star Chromotherapy lighting system Natural Reforested Canadian Hemlock wood construction Electrical service: Requires 3 individual 240V/30A dedicated receptacles (Please consult a certified electrician.) (Sauna comes with 3 power supplies to operate) Clasp together assembly 23 Carbon PureTech™ Near Zero EMF Heat Emitters (Heating Panels) Extra wide bronze privacy tempered glass door (Wheelchair accessible) Roof vent Specifications Exterior dimensions (WDH): 87″ x 75″ x 87″ Interior dimensions (WDH): 82″ x 70″ x 82″ Sauna weight: 920 lbs. Shipping weight: 1130 lbs. Ships in 9 boxes All Golden Designs Saunas Include a 5-Year Limited Warranty. View more details here. What are you waiting for? Order your infrared sauna today and experience the Golden Designs difference. Videos
